coverage_status_note: Sites located through their serving utilities and measured against the grid.
claims_absent_note: Measured from the grid up: every site located through the utility that actually serves it, then settled against nine years of federal meter data.

sites.note: Colocation. Same caveat as DLR: the load belongs to tenants, and the utility is inferred from the footprint.

confidence=medium. Equinix lists IBX AT1 at Atlanta GA 30303 on its own page. COLOCATION: the load is drawn by Equinix's TENANTS, not by the REIT, which leases space and power. Georgia Power is the Atlanta core utility; that link is inferred but the BA is unambiguous.

confidence=medium. Equinix lists IBX CH2 at Chicago IL 60616 on its own page. COLOCATION: the metered load is TENANTS' IT equipment, not the REIT's. ComEd is the Chicago utility; that link is inferred, the BA is unambiguous.

confidence=medium. Equinix lists IBX DA1 at Dallas TX 75207 on its own page. COLOCATION: the load belongs to TENANTS. Oncor is the Dallas TDU; that link is inferred, the BA and ERCOT zone are unambiguous.

confidence=high. Equinix's own page gives SV1 at 11 Great Oaks Boulevard San Jose CA 95119. San Jose is PG&E and NOT Silicon Valley Power: do not generalise this row to Santa Clara colo a few miles away, which is on a municipal utility. COLOCATION: load is TENANTS'.
confidence=high. Equinix's own page gives NY4 at 755 Secaucus Rd Secaucus NJ 07094. Secaucus is PSE&G, the PJM PSEG zone. COLOCATION: the load belongs to TENANTS.

talk_score_method: magnitude x specificity x scope_breadth, 0-1. How big the number is, how precisely it is stated, and how little it is hedged. Narrowing qualifiers (annual, market-based, certificates, owned-and-operated) reduce scope_breadth.
walk_score_method: mean physical carbon-free share across mapped sites, calendar 2025, all hours, grid-only, unweighted by site size.
notes: Grid-only. Excludes power purchase agreements and renewable energy certificates.
Unweighted across sites; we do not know each site's load.
Site mapping is hand-curated from serving utilities, never inferred from state.
Annual matched claims are TRUE under the GHG Protocol market-based method. The verdict is 'true on paper, X physically', not an accusation.
Measured from the grid up: every site located through the utility that actually serves it, then settled against nine years of federal meter data.
